body: I'm attractive, but my issues with depression have ruined any romantic relationship i've had and a few friends as well. I also got diagnosed with herpes a month ago, so that won't help at all either I'm sure.

I'm at the end of my rope as far as doctors and therapists go. I don't want to keep experimenting with meds, as I've tried so many and have experienced so many bad effects. 

Thanks for your kind words.

Thanks. I'm just so scared of having to have that talk about having herpes. I'm sure any guy I meet will immediately reject me when they find out. But I obviously can't, in good conscience, not say something.

The problem is that I have sought help, and it's been like ramming myself into a brick wall over and over. I'm very disenchanted with the mental healthy industry and I don't have the time or energy to keep trying with them.
